_comment: Copy this to ~/.vibelog/secrets.json (chmod 600) and fill in only what you use. VibeLog reads NO environment variables — every credential lives here, outside the repo, and is never logged or sent to the overlay/state.json. All fields are optional: with none set, VibeLog runs in zero-config local mode (template summaries, no social stats, no integrations). See docs/INFRA_PLAN.md §1/§4.
_publish_comment: Cloud publisher (V1 MVP). Set url+token to push the public { state, profile, theme } snapshot to your Cloudflare Worker so your /live page stays up 24/7. The token is secret (must match the Worker's PUBLISH_TOKEN). Leave url/token blank to disable (no-op). Cadence optional — defaults: 300s while live / 900s idle, write-on-change.
